question: Which of the following is not a bone in babies at birth?
solution:
The correct answer is**__ __**__**Kneecap** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

 
• Babies are born without the kneecap (or patella).
 
• The kneecap starts out as cartilage and starts significantly hardening into bone between the ages of 2 and 6 years old.
